sentences.text:
Nereti Koteswara Rao, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 12
March, 2020

Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
Bench: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy

1
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy

Criminal Petition No.1430 of 2020
Order:
 This petition is filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C
seeking quash of Fir in Crime No.60/2020 of Mangalagiri (R)
Police Station, Guntur Urban District.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner.
3. The petitioner is accused No.1 in Crime No.60/2020 of Mangalagiri (R) Police Station, Guntur Urban District.

entities.text: Mangalagiri (R) Police Station, Guntur Urban District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: He is being prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 and 353 of IPC and under Sections 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act.

4. The issue is squarely covered by three judgments of this Court whereunder criminal proceedings launched against va rious persons in the said petitions of similar nature are quashed by this Court as not maintainable under law.

This Court in Crl.P. No.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27-8- 2018; in Crl.P. No.5421 of 2019 and batch, dated 18-12- 2019; and in Crl.P. No.5103 of 2019 and batch, dated 05-4- Nereti Koteswara Rao, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 12 March, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199576832/
1 2020, held that the prosecution under the aforesaid Sections of law in the facts and circumstances of the case is not maintainable under law.
Therefore, the petitioner herein, who is also similarly placed, who is facing the prosecution for the same nature of offences, is also entitled to the similar relief.

5 . Hence, in view of the aforesaid judgments of this Court, the petition is allowed and the criminal prosecution  2 launched against the petitioner in Crime No.60/2020 of Mangalagiri (R) Police Station, Guntur Urban District,
is hereby quashed.
